title: Aye Aon o Mohd Mere Waade Ko Nibhaana
body:
Zainab ne kaha laut key maidan se na aana
Aye aoun-o-mohammed mere wade ko nibhana
Jaffer ke jigar band ho Hyder ki nazar ho
Shagird-e-alamdar ho Zainab key pisar ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Dada ki tarah jung mein, talwar chalana
Tum share ho jarrar ho karrar ho pyaro
Mamu ki tarah tum bhi wafadar ho pyaro
Pyase ho magar bhul key, darya pe na jana
<<DIVIDER>>
Madar ki nasiyath ko sada dhiyan mein rakhna
Paani kabhi peene ka bhi arman na karna
Pyase hai teen roz key, Asghar wo Sakina
Mai sounchti thi waqt pade jab bhi aqi par
<<DIVIDER>>
Kardungi fida tumko mein aulade Ali par
Jis tarah se ho deene, muhammed ko bachana
Foujey shaqi ney ghera hein farzand-e-nabi ko
Allah salamath rakhey duniya mein aqi ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum dono mere bhai pe, jaan apni lutana
Ghodey se girein run mein jo Hyder key nawase
Zaqmoun sey chur chur they Mazhar wo dulhare
Ta hashar mein ye yaad, rakhega ye zamana
